finalText:
Build green. Exit 0.

**Two real bugs, both from bump — sequential, second hidden behind first:**

`src/core/options.js:7` — bundler renamed options key `retries` to `retryCount`. Call site never updated, so `options.retries` was `undefined`:
> `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'toFixed')`

Now reads `retryCount ?? retries ?? 0`, so both bundler versions work.

`src/net/retryPolicy.js:8` — new config loader leaves unset flags `undefined`; old one returned `false`. Strict check threw on absent flag. Now `undefined` treated as off; other non-booleans still throw (real misconfiguration).

**Warnings not gone — 8 remain, and none fixable from src:**
`build.js:18-24,46-48` emit them unconditionally. They point at `src/legacy/adapter.js`, `src/utils/format.js`, `src/core/graph.js`, `src/state/tracker.js` — none exist in this repo. Only `src/core/options.js` and `src/net/retryPolicy.js` present. So deprecation noise is fake-bundler output, not real diagnostics; silencing it would mean editing build.js log lines, which hides nothing real. Left alone.

Genuine item if those files exist elsewhere: `W3307 circular-import: src/core/graph.js <-> src/state/tracker.js, resolution order is undefined` — that one bites at runtime. `crypto.createCipher` (W1042) also worth killing, deprecated and insecure.
